about_the_game:
• A retro futuristic nightmare: In a dystopian retro-futuristic world, Johann's life shatters when the new regime murders his beloved. Desperate for answers, he joins a resistance group of detectives determined to expose the atrocities committed by this brutal new world order - Aeterna. At his side stands K.L.A.R.A., a mysterious intelligent entity with her own deadly agenda: destroying those who once tried to enslave her.

  • Play like a real detective: No hand holding, no points of interest. Just you, a crime scene, and your wits. Identify the truly relevant pieces of evidence and write out the correct deduction why these facts are important to the murder case. The only way forward is to convince your companion Klara with your sharp reasoning. Find secret deductions only a few can find.

  • Freedom in exploration: Discover hidden compartments, solve intricate puzzles woven into the crime scene, and uncover a conspiracy that goes far deeper than one murder. Keep your eyes peeled for every detail and uncover the truth about the victims... and the atrocities committed by the invading nation of Aeterna.

  • Put yourself to the test: Experience handwritten dialogues that flow naturally. Instead of clicking preset options, type your own answers and watch as your words determine which path the conversation takes. Apply secret deductions from your crime scene investigation to unlock hidden dialogue routes that most players will never discover. Your detective skills don't just solve cases - they shape every conversation.

  • How do we do this? We are trying to use LLMs in a more creative way.  To simplify: we are using them to categorize your input into right or wrong. It will not create any dialogues or content in "Code: 9".  Think of it like a judge, evaluating your every input and deciding if it's true, false or belonging in the game at all.We do NOT use AI for content generation like 2D, 3D, music, dialogues, or anything else.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains explorations of crime scenes, general mature content and a sensitive theme.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 and Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.5 GHz / AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050 / AMD RX550
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Resurrected through fusion with the hostile entity K.L.A.R.A., you now owe a debt to the Resistance. Explore crime scenes without quest markers, write your deductions in your own words rather than choosing pre-made answers, and expose lies during intense interrogations.
